Landing.seoTitle: Your real Vedic Kundli — computed, not guessed
Landing.seoIntro: A Kundli (birth chart) is a map of the planets at your exact moment of birth. Most online kundli tools give you a canned PDF. Arya does something different: it computes your chart with the Swiss Ephemeris (sidereal, Lahiri ayanamsa) and then talks to you about it — in Hindi, Marathi or English.
Landing.seoBody1: Enter your birth date, time and place. Arya works out your Lagna (ascendant), Rashi (Moon sign), Nakshatra (the 27 lunar mansions) and current Vimshottari Dasha in seconds. Then ask about what matters to you — marriage timing, career moves, money, health, or Kundli matching with a partner.
Landing.seoBody2: Every answer is grounded in your real chart and today's actual planetary transits — never a generic horoscope. Whether you want to know when you'll get married, whether a career change is coming, or how compatible you are with someone, the reading is personal to your Dasha, not your sun sign.
Landing.faq1A: A Kundli is a map of where the planets were at your exact birth moment. It shows your Lagna (ascendant), Rashi (Moon sign), Nakshatra and Dasha periods, which astrologers use to read your life themes.
Landing.faq2Q: How do I get my Kundli online for free?
Landing.faq2A: Enter your birth date, time and place of birth on Jyotish. Arya computes your full Vedic chart instantly and free — you only pay if you want to keep asking questions in the chat.
Landing.faq3A: A Nakshatra is one of the 27 lunar mansions the Moon occupies at your birth. It adds a deeper layer to your Moon sign and is used for timing, compatibility and remedies in Vedic astrology.
Landing.faq4Q: Is Vedic astrology different from sun-sign horoscopes?
Landing.faq4A: Yes. Vedic (sidereal) astrology uses the real, fixed positions of the stars, not the seasonal zodiac. Your Moon sign and Dasha carry more weight than your sun sign, which is why the readings feel more personal.
Landing.faq5A: Marriage timing is read from your 7th house, Venus, Saturn and your current Dasha. Arya can look at your chart and give you the strongest windows — ask directly in the chat.
Landing.faq6Q: Do I need to know my exact birth time?
Landing.faq6A: No. If you don't know it, we use 12:00 PM — your Rashi and Nakshatra stay reliable, and the reading still works for most questions.

Terms.lagna: Lagna (ascendant) is the sign rising on the eastern horizon at your birth. It shapes your personality and body.
Terms.rashi: Rashi is your Moon sign — the sign the Moon was in at birth. It reflects your mind, emotions and inner nature.
Terms.nakshatra: A Nakshatra is one of 27 lunar mansions the Moon occupies. It adds deeper flavour to your Moon sign.
Terms.dasha: Vimshottari Dasha divides your life into planetary periods. Each period's lord colours the events of those years.
Terms.planet: The 9 planets (navagraha) each rule different areas of life — Sun (career/authority), Moon (mind), Venus (love), etc.
Terms.house: Houses are the 12 life areas in a chart. The 1st is self, 7th is marriage, 10th is career, 11th is gains.
Terms.retrograde: A retrograde planet appears to move backwards in the sky. It turns a planet's energy inward or makes it slower.
